$description: Design preview tokens (stage 1). Slots are the visual properties of the component; each variant maps every slot to a semantic token id. Edited live in the documentation site (Design preview tab). Proposals until the spec is approved.

overlay.description: Dimmed background over the page, around the image

edge.description: Space between the screen edges and the image / close button

band-background.description: Solid band under the image (previous and next buttons)

band-gap.description: Space between the previous and next buttons
